title: Buried UFO too big to move
summary: Ross Coulthart tells of Buried UFO too big to move, about undated at undisclosed sensitive site, and reports it citing named sources. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I do not resile from saying what I've said previously, which is that there is a buried or at least built upon UFO that was too big to move.

as_told.title: Ross Coulthart: buried UFO too big to move

plain: A journalist, Ross Coulthart, says that at a sensitive site he does not name there is a UFO that was too big to move, so it was buried or had something built on top of it. He says he stands by having said this before. If true, it would mean the government is holding an actual craft in place.
